SQLite (k3s default datastore) cannot be used on clusters with multiple servers

k3s SQLite backup needs no special commands: copy /var/lib/rancher/k3s/server/db/ plus the server token file; without the same token the backup is unusable
k3s embedded-etcd snapshots run by default at 00:00 and 12:00, keep 5 per server, and can be copied to S3-compatible storage
k3s minor-version rollback is only possible by restoring a datastore snapshot taken on the older version; without it rollback is impossible
system-upgrade-controller does not protect against skipping minor versions, and the k3s-upgrade image refuses to downgrade the control plane
